name: medical-research-council
description: A council of specialist AI reviewers that pressure-tests medical research topics, protocols, grants, manuscripts, and MedTech projects.

interface.shortDescription: Specialist review board for medical research decisions
interface.longDescription: Runs a research topic, protocol, grant, manuscript, or MedTech project past five specialist reviewers who work independently, review each other anonymously, and are scored with a safety and ethics veto. Every reference in the verdict is checked against a literature search.
defaultPrompt: Run the medical research council on my study idea.
Which of these research topics should I pursue first?
